Class Student

java.lang.Object
project.models.actors.User
project.models.actors.Student
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, JournalObserver
Direct Known Subclasses:
GraduateStudent
public class Student extends User
Undergraduate student. Manages course enrollment (capped at 21 credits), tracks GPA from marks, and can join student organizations. Exceeding 3 course failures blocks further registration.

  • Method Details

    • registerForCourse

      public boolean registerForCourse(Course course)
      Attempts to enrol the student in the given course. Rejects if the 21-credit cap would be exceeded or the student is already enrolled.
      Parameters:
      course - the course to register for
      Returns:
      true if registration succeeded, false otherwise

    • dropCourse

      public boolean dropCourse(Course course)
      Drops the student from the given course and reduces their total credits.
      Parameters:
      course - the course to drop
      Returns:
      true if the course was found and removed, false if not enrolled

    • incrementFailCount

      public void incrementFailCount()
      Increments the failure counter and alerts if the student has exceeded the 3-failure limit. Called automatically by MarkService when a mark below 50 is assigned.

    • hasExceededFailLimit

      public boolean hasExceededFailLimit()
      Returns true if the student has failed more than 3 courses and cannot register for new ones.

    • viewTranscript

      public void viewTranscript()
      Prints a formatted transcript to stdout showing marks, letter grades, GPA, credits, and fail count. Recalculates GPA and fail count from the database before printing.

    • recalculateGpa

      public void recalculateGpa()
      Recomputes GPA from the latest mark in every registered course. Call this before displaying grades.

    • recalculateFailCount

      public void recalculateFailCount()
      Re-counts failed courses from the database. A course is failed when its total mark is below 50.
